name: Night Kin
detailed_description:
Night Kin is an immersive single-player post-apocalyptic survival FPS set in the war-torn ruins of near-future Southeast Europe. Embark on unforgiving expeditions, scavenge valuable resources, and do whatever it takes to survive. Build a network of hideouts, adapt to a ruthless world, and uncover the secrets of a land where myth and modern warfare collide.

Explore the Unknown

Embark on unforgiving expeditions across a vast, interconnected world of handcrafted maps, each shrouded in mystery, death, and darkness. Survive through strategic decision-making, establish a network of hideouts, and take on quests and contracts. Secure valuable resources, high-value loot, and fight for survival in intense, dynamic battles.

Stay Combat Ready

Plan your engagements or adapt on the fly with a vast arsenal of Cold War-era, modern, and near-future weapons. Weapons degrade over time and require maintenance but can be customized for any combat scenario. Learn the terrain, uncover hidden routes, track weather patterns, and embrace the dangers of the night. Every strategy is valid, and player mastery is always rewarded.

Build Your Own Path

Establish a network of hideouts across the game world—personal, customizable and upgradable bases for saving progress, crafting, and storage. Claim abandoned structures scattered throughout each region and transform them into safe havens, creating strategic routes for safer expeditions as you take on quests and contracts.

Unravel the Truth in a World Where Myth and War Collide

Piece together a story shrouded in mystery and uncover the secrets of a world destroyed by war, where myth and modern warfare collide. Encounter a diverse cast of characters from all sides of the war, coming from different lands, holding their own beliefs, and concealing layers of secrets. Their histories trace back to the early days of the war, the downfall of civilization, and the countless rumors of impossible events unfolding in the present.

The more you uncover, the deeper your understanding of faction motivations, character backstories, and the uncertain future of humanity will become.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (AVX2 support required).
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080, 8GB / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER, 8GB / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060, 8GB / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060, 8GB / AMD Radeon RX 5700, 8GB / AMD Radeon RX 6600, 8GB / Intel Arc A770, 8GB.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requirements for 60 FPS gameplay on the Medium graphics preset at 1080p. An SSD is required for fast load times and smooth shader compilation.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (latest update) or Windows 11 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X.
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requirements for 60–90 FPS gameplay on the Very High graphics preset at 1080p. An SSD is required for fast load times and smooth shader compilation.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content that may not be suitable for all ages or appropriate for viewing at work, including frequent violence, gore, and mature themes.
